cs.t: Unpopular opinion (even wsj wrote this product off [1]) but as a new dad these things have been an absolute game changer. I continue to play with my toddler at all times but I can also capture critical moments without my kid thinking I’m constantly on my phone. The grandparents have the footage on loop. This is just a win-win-win all around tbh even without any displays. [1]:  https://www.wsj.com/articles/metas-ray-ban-smart-glasses-fai...  PS: added benefit that when I don’t pick up my phone to get to the camera constantly I conveniently miss the attention destroying notifications  most times from other Meta products  PPS: Caveat: I live in a sunny location so sunglasses make sense most days.
cs.th: Ray-Ban Meta next generation of smart glasses

cs.t: I tried the previous ones. Those were chunky, cheap looking plastic like a kids toy, inconvenient, and expensive. There's no display, they're basically just worse than earbuds.
cs.th: Ray-Ban Meta next generation of smart glasses

cs.t:
They're actually good and have nearly replaced my airpods.
I don't need glasses and don't live in SF so I do feel a bit pretentious though. The potential is definitely there and I'd be very surprised if the Meta Reality Labs team haven't already added heaps of feature internally and are just waiting or staggering releases.
